title: Microsoft Copilot: new rich answer cards for weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and keeps unconfirmed answer-card behaviour separate from documented web search controls. Minor corrections should restore the policy-page heading in the admin path and explicitly name the API's mode property.

## April 21, 2026
Updates released between April 7, 2026, April 21, 2026

**Rich Bing web answer cards in Copilot Chat** [Windows, Web]
**Roadmap ID:**[500865]

claims.claim: The separate release-notes entry describes Bing web answer cards such as Weather and Stocks in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat will now show Bing's rich and interactive answer cards-such as Weather, Stocks, and other structured information-when users ask related questions.

claims.claim: Copilot web search sends a generated search query to the Bing search service.
claims.quote: Based on these terms, Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information.

claims.claim: Copilot also sends the user's client IP address when making a Bing web search request.
claims.quote: When Copilot sends a web search request to the Bing search service, it also sends the user's client IP address, which Bing uses to help localize results, such as nearby weather and events.

claims.claim: The Data Protection Addendum does not apply to generated web search queries.
claims.quote: doesn't apply to the use of generated web search queries in Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Chat, or the Bing search service.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the web search setting once using the preview TCM baseline.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors
mode | monitorMode | The monitor mode. The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue.
claims.fix: Keep the call. Replace 'Preview TCM: applyOnce, microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch, value 0, 1 or 2' in the row note with 'Preview TCM: set mode to applyOnce; in baseline.resources, set resourceType to microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch and properties.value to the string 0, 1 or 2'. The create reference documents mode; https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources documents the resource and value.

claims.claim: The TCM resource for this policy is microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch"

claims.claim: The resource's value accepts 0, 1 or 2.
claims.quote: value | Write | String | Controls web search. 0 enables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. 1 disables it in both. 2 disables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot Work mode

claims.claim: The TCM Copilot resource support is preview.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta.

claims.claim: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: Configuring the target setting in any group-level policy causes TCM monitoring, snapshots, remediation and applyOnce to fail for that resource.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the least-privileged signed-in user role for TCM remediation and applyOnce on this resource.
claims.quote: AI Administrator is the least-privileged role for the signed-in user for remediation and applyOnce; don't assign that user-role requirement to the service principal.

claims.claim: A user-level Web content toggle exists.
claims.quote: The Web content toggle gives users control over whether Microsoft Copilot includes real-time web content in responses and is now available to both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat users.

claims.claim: When an administrator turns off web search, the Web content toggle is turned off and dimmed.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns off web search, the Web content toggle is turned off and appears dimmed. Users can't turn on the toggle to use web search.

claims.claim: In the listed commercial cloud, an unconfigured Allow web search in Copilot policy leaves web search available, subject to the optional connected experiences exception.
claims.quote: If the IT admin doesn't configure the Allow web search in Copilot policy, web search will be available to users in both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat

claims.claim: Setting Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office to Disabled prevents that unconfigured-policy web search availability.
claims.quote: unless the IT admin has set the Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office policy to Disabled.
